name: io.github.oooooasis-fds/factor-data
title: ooooOasis Factor Data
description: Point-in-time factor data for North American equities: 583 tickers, 180 factors, SEC facts.

tools.name: factor_asof
tools.description: Current value of one factor for one ticker. Free tier: S&P 500 Top-100 ticker x one of the 37 recognized factors, one call at a time. as_of is required (YYYY-MM-DD). 252-day IV Rank is not yet available (n/a, earliest ~2027-11) and is never substituted by the realized-vol percentile. Returns the factor value row.

factor.description: Factor name, e.g. rsi14 (one of the recognized factors).

as_of.description: Date to take the value as of, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-20.

tools.name: factor_meta
tools.description: Factor service metadata (snapshot time, row counts). Public: no key needed, not counted.
